lines: Marks has taken on more work lately. He played 67% of snaps over his last 3 games, up from 60% on the season, and averaged 16.3 carries, up from 11.9.
The extra carries haven't turned into many more points. He averaged 8.3 PPR points over his last 3 games, against 8.7 on the season, with just 2.0 targets a game.
Coach DeMeco Ryans said Marks will likely miss Thursday night's game against the Colts while in the concussion protocol. Our projection gives him a 15% chance to play.
